title: Fringe Show 23: Potty the Plant ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ #edfringe #theatre #theatrer...
transcript: Move aside, Audrey 2, because there is a new singing plant puppet in musical theater, and that is the title character of potty the Plant. Potty the plant is a dark comedy musical about all of these children that seem to be disappearing after going to visit the doctor. Doctor Acula, who may or may not be a vampire, and a group of the nurses that work in the doctor's office along with the potted plant. Potty try to solve the mystery of the missing kids. And this musical is fun and silly with catchy contemporary musical theater tunes and humor that definitely gives off early star kid vibes. And if you don't believe me on the catchy tunes, you can listen to the cast recording. There is one available on all streaming platforms. This was the second year that potty the plant has been at fringe, so they released this to coincide with the latest run. This show was silly and fun, and I do wish I was invested in the characters arcs a little bit more, but for the most part it was an enjoyable watch. And you know, I love a good puppet, and potty the plant is an adorable puppet, and there was some really fun comedy using the puppetry. I wish that the musical had leaned a little more into the horror comedy genre than it did, this is a fun time, especially for anybody that's a fan of Little Shop or early Star Kid musicals
